articleTitle: Exploring Machine Learning Models for Intelligent Sentiment Analysis in Financial Services
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: This paper explores device learning processes for sentiment evaluation in financial services. The authors used diverse gadgets, gaining knowledge of fashions and algorithms to procedure textual records and generate sentiment rankings for extraordinary monetary merchandise. The authors analyzed one-of-a-kind features of the texts, including sentiment phrases and expressions, to determine the sentiment of the texts. They also extracted applicable economic sentiment topics from the texts and compared their performance. The results indicate that the system gaining knowledge of models can benefit sentiment analysis in economic offerings. Additionally, the effects advise that neural networks are suitable for sentiment analysis tasks, even as texts with excessive sentiment words and expressions are extra dependable.

articleTitle: ISLC SCNN: Indian Sign Language Classification System Using Shallow Convolution Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Sign language is the primary communication of the vocal and auditory impaired. Sign language includes hand gestures, facial emotions, and lip movements. Learning sign language helps in accessible communication with the impaired and promotes inclusivity. Sign language translation can be implemented using machine learning techniques to help the impaired seamlessly access their surrounding facilities equivalent to others. Indian Sign Language (ISL) has standard numbers (1–9) and English alphabets (A-Z) signs and expressions. Image classification using convolution neural networks (CNNs) is effective in computer vision and applications. The classification of ISL is challenging to implement through deep neural architectures in the real world due to their high computational complexity. This paper proposes a shallow convolution neural network (SCNN) to extract features and classify static sign-gesture images. To validate the performance of SCNN, we have tested the proposed model on the Kaggle Indian Sign Language (ISL) dataset. Our experimental results show that the proposed SCNN has achieved 98% validation accuracy and 98% F 1 score. We have proposed a composite score metric for performance analysis and hyper-parameter tuning. We have also validated the performance of SCNN on Sobel features of the Kaggle ISL Dataset. Data augmentation techniques and their effects on SCNN performance and analysis are explored through overfitting scenarios. The results indicate that SCNN performs significantly compared to existing deep learning models with less computational costs and lower training time.

articleTitle: GUI-Enabled Fusion of U-Net and ResNet-34 for Building Classification and Change Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Studies predicted that India's urbanization rate have reached 35.9% by 2022. After Tamil Nadu and Kerala, India's third-most urbanized state is Maharashtra. It is home to 45.23% of the nation's urban residents. The primary focus of remote sensing in urban environments has been the classification and detection from satellite images. However, classifying buildings and detecting changes in metropolitan regions using very high resolution satellite (VHRS) images is challenging due to complex architecture and a lack of annotated data. Existing methods for building detection and classification, often lead to low accuracy rates in urban areas due to the variability in building shapes, orientations, and perspectives. To accomplish this task, a Graphical User Interface featuring a deep learning model for semantic segmentation using U-Net with ResNet-34 backbone has been proposed.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Indian Sign Language Recognition for People with Speech and Hearing Impairment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Languages that transmit meaning through the visual-manual modality as opposed to spoken words are known as sign languages. This visual language uses hand gestures and body postures when spoken communication is not possible or preferred. It is used by speech and hearing impaired individuals individuals to convey meaning. Therefore introducing a tech- nology capable of comprehending sign language could greatly enhance the social interactions and quality of life for deaf people. In contrast to ASL's single-handed gestures., ISL relies on bilateral hand motions to communicate. The suggested approach is convolution neural network(CNN) which translate the sign language into legible text. The collected data is preprocessed and used as input to CNN. We examined many cutting-edge architectures, including CNN, VGG16, and AlexNet, to tackle the issue of identifying Indian sign language. Among these archi- tectures, CNN architecture gave the best results. It is observed that the model gives 99.93% accuracy on test data. Tensorflow object detection is used in the suggested method to identify hand motions. With our system, the deaf community can communicate more easily and efficiently, without relying on external help.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Prediction Using CNN Architecture and Augmentation Techniques: Analytical Results
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The brain, a complex organ central to human functioning, is susceptible to the development of abnormal cell growth leading to a condition known as brain cancer. This devastating disease poses unique challenges due to the intricate nature of brain tissue, making accurate and timely diagnosis critical for effective treatment. This research explores automated brain tumor prediction through Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and augmentation techniques. Utilizing a task reused learning approach with the help of VGG-16, Mobile-Net and Xception architecture, the proposed model achieves exceptional accuracy (99.54%, 99.72%) and robust metrics. This Research explores the Augmentation techniques to enhance the precision and accuracy of the model used. The study surveys related models, emphasizing advancements in automated brain tumor classification. Results demonstrate the efficacy of the model, showcasing its potential for real-world applications in medical image analysis. Future directions involve dataset expansion, alternative architectures, and incorporating explanation techniques. This research contributes to the evolving landscape of artificial intelligence in healthcare, offering a promising avenue for accurate and efficient brain tumor diagnosis.

articleTitle: Characteristic Mode Analysis of Closed Metal Geometric Ring Shapes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: In this study, the characteristic mode theory is used to better explain the physical behavior of a few simple closedshaped geometries. The bandwidth coverage, resonant behavior, and modal current distributions for several ringshaped geometries are shown and discussed. It has been demonstrated that the triangular, rectangular, and square ring geometries can result in multi-band performance, whereas the hexagonal, circular, square, and triangular rings are promising candidates for circularly polarized antenna designs.

articleTitle: Plant Leaf Disease Detection System using Single Shot Detector YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Agriculture is the primary sector for millions of farmers in India. Due to the increase in significant climatic fluctuations and continual decline of the yield's quality in agricultural field, detection of plant diseases in their initial stages and treating them at the earliest is the challenging task. The most important thing is the identification of plant diseases accurately and how to control them effectively so that the farmers can enhance the quality of yield. This cannot be achieved by the traditional method of examining them manually which is a time taking process further reducing the efficiency in the yield's quality. To address this problem a diverse set of ML algorithms, ranging from classic supervised learning models to advanced deep learning architectures are applied on varied datasets. The YOLO model introduces increased detection speed and enhanced accuracy, specifically excelling in identifying real-time objects, including those of smaller sizes. This paper focuses the latest version of YOLO i.e., YOLOv8 for experimenting its performance for detecting diseases in plants, on a multi-species Plantdoc dataset. According to the results of the YOLOv8 model, it is proved to be the fastest single stage object detection model compared to other versions of YOLO. It has obtained mAP, Precision and Recall of 0.79, 0.61 and 0.79 respectively at IoU=0.5 on 30 different plant class labels.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a 3-Axis Articulated Camera Stabilizer for Terrain Exploration with Rovers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: This paper presents the design and development of an Articulated Arm Stabilization System (AASS) tailored for rovers, with a focus on versatility and adaptability across diverse applications and terrains. In contemporary scenarios, achieving a stable platform is imperative to counteract motion-induced vibrations that could compromise equipment performance. The AASS proactively addresses these challenges, ensuring a steady platform by mitigating vibrations before impacting the mounted equipment on the rover's articulated arm. The rover itself is ingeniously crafted to seamlessly integrate with the articulated arm, showcasing adaptability to traverse various terrains. The innovative stabilization technology plays a pivotal role in sustaining stability during rover navigation across diverse landscapes, promising to revolutionize the field by enabling efficient and precise task execution, even in challenging environments.

articleTitle: Privacy Preserving content-based image retrieval using Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The PP-CBIR system integrates advanced methodologies from computer vision and cryptography. Utilizing Dense Net as the feature extractor, it employs deep learning for image feature extraction. This results in a fully operational PP-CBIR system that securely stores and retrieves images while prioritizing user privacy. Through the incorporation of homomorphic encryption, the system guarantees the confidentiality of image features, allowing for retrieval without privacy compromise

articleTitle: Modified Arithmetic Coding to Increase the Compression Rate of Text Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: In the past two decades, hardware and software have advanced quickly due to technological advancement. Global data distribution and storage have become simpler as a result. However, the bandwidth cannot handle the volume of information being created. As a result, researchers are now looking into data compression. Numerous data compression techniques have been developed, including Shannon Fano, Huffman, Lempel Ziv, and Arithmetic coding techniques. Characters are typically expressed in ASCII code using a predetermined number of bits per character. Lossless data compression uses an entropy coding method called Arithmetic Coding (AC). In the arithmetic encoding of a string similar to Huffman coding, symbols seen frequently are encoded with more bits than symbols seen less frequently. Unlike other entropy encoding techniques like Huffman coding, a single arbitrary-precision fraction between 0 and 1 encodes the entire message in arithmetic coding. In this proposed method, the arbitrary-precision fraction is converted into its equivalent binary form, split into groups of 8 bits, and converted into its identical UTF-8-character set, whose length is far lower than the arbitrary-precision fraction. Huffman code is used to compress further the UTF-8 character set.

articleTitle: Theoretical Framework for Integrating IoT and Explainable AI in a Smart Home Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Using IoT devices in smart homes brings benefits and security dangers. This study extensively examines various intrusion detection methods within smart home environments. It also suggests a novel hybrid intrusion detection theoretical framework integrating IoT data with Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) approaches. Using information from multiple IoT devices, including motion sensors, door/window sensors, cameras, and temperature sensors, our theoretical framework can create a comprehensive image of the home environment. By effectively detecting new threats, it offers anomaly detection utilizing unsupervised learning approaches to discover potential breaches without tagged data.

Author Keywords: Privacy Preservation and Smart Home Control

articleTitle: High Gain Miniature Antenna Arrays for 2.4 GHz Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: In this paper, miniature corporate feed Four Element Array (FEA), Eight Element Array (EEA) and Sixteen Element Array (SEA) are presented. The proposed antenna arrays are created on Rogers Duroid 5880 substrate with permittivity 2.2 and thickness of 0.782 mm. Initially, a single element antenna was created, then it was used in a corporate feed network designed for the 4-element array. As an extension, the 4-element array was used as a template and created an 8-element array and 16-element array to achieve high gain and directivity at 2.4 GHz. The proposed FEA, EEA, and SEA exhibit reflection coefficients of −25.55 dB, −37.14 dB, and −30.61 dB respectively. The peak gains obtained are 11.5 dB, 13.67 dB, and 16.76 dB respectively for FEA, EEA, and SEA. Also, the directivity has improved corresponding to the increase in the number of elements. Therefore, it can be a suitable candidate for applicationswhere extended range and coverage with better signal quality and higher data transfer rates is a priority.

articleTitle: Enhanced Retinal Vessel Segmentation Using U-Net Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The key step in retinal imaging is blood vessel augmentation, which is important for early diagnosing eye conditions such as glaucoma, macular edema, diabetic retinopathy, and more. Deep learning has been used in the segmentation process for the last few years due to its high accuracy and efficiency. We have proposed a convolutional neural network based on U-net to segment blood vessel fundus images in this paper. The publicly available DRIVE and CHASE DB1 datasets were used to train the model and for testing, the HRF dataset was used. For the DRIVE dataset, the research findings show an average accuracy of 93.2 percent.

articleTitle: Enhanced Level Brain Tumor Identification Using CNN, VGG16 and ResNet Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The comprehension of brain growths is significantly improved through the identification and categorization of these disorders. Still, their discovery is relatively grueling due to their variability in terms of position, shape, and size. Fortunately, deep literacy has revolutionized the field and significantly improved recognition, prediction, and opinion in various healthcare areas, including brain excrescences. The main goal of this study is to thoroughly review exploration that utilizes CNN, VGG16, and RESNET infrastructures to classify brain excrescences using MRI images. The performance of these models varied significantly, with CNN, VGG16, and RESNET achieving an emotional delicacy of 99.6. Additionally, ResNet and VGG16 achieved rigor of 92.4 and 89.7 independently. Likewise, the visualization of the decision-making processes of these models has provided valuable insight into the features they prioritize. By incorporating these models into their practice, healthcare professionals have the opportunity to enhance their individual capabilities, eventually leading to improved patient outcomes.

articleTitle: An Improved Henon Map Based Encryption Scheme for Secure Image Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Image transmission over insecure public communication channels is vulnerable to various security threats. To ensure the confidentiality of the image during transmission, the message can be encrypted, which effectively transforms it into an unrecognizable format. More robust security methods than conventional security methods such as AES and DES are necessary to ensure secure image transmission over public networks due to the exclusive features of image data, such as a high level of redundancy and large size. Therefore, it is essential to explore alternative security methods for image transmission. One practical and efficient method for image encryption is chaotic map-based encryption, which has a distinctive property of high sensitivity to initial conditions. This paper proposes a secure image encryption scheme using the Arnold cat map and an improved version of the classical Hénon map to encrypt the image for a more comprehensive chaotic range. Simulation and theoretical evaluation confirm the efficacy of the proposed encryption scheme, ensuring the image's secrecy during transmission.

articleTitle: Posture Identification and Detection for Understanding Cognitive Behavior
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Human posture recognition has been of interest for the better part of the past decade due to its advantages in multiple domains. It has been noticed that human posture is correlated to their cognition or the environment they are subjected to. However, detecting and distinguishing body postures is impacted by several barriers such as environment, background, sounds, and so on. Hence, we try to correlate these external factors with human postures influenced due to their cognition. In this study, we attempt to develop a model that will be able to distinguish the postures caused due to diverse emotional and external factors. This is being done to further challenge computer vision to integrate with multimodal neurological features to identify whether the subject in question is under stress or not. The following study encompasses 3 different approaches using with the features to find the best working usable model.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling and Profit Analysis by using RPGT
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: In our present work, five subsystems like a tilter system (P), a dough hopper (Q), a cutter (S), a conveyor (T) and a rotating system (R) that make up a biscuit plant are described. Purpose of this study to find the profit analysis, which depends upon Markov modeling for grouping parametric equation to examine the transient behavior of repairable biscuit manufacturing plant by using RPGT. To achieve the maximum profit, the result of defective and repairable unit is investigated and alone repairman will inspect and fix the appliances when they require it. Through the help of Regenerative Process (RPGT), Availability of the biscuit plant is assessed, and accessibility of the biscuit plant's configuration for various repair and failure rates of the subsystem is also assessed. The behavior of profits is discussed through tables and graphs. Profit increases when defective charges and repair charges decrease and profit reduces when defective and repair charges increase.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Low-Profile Z-Shaped Patch Antenna For n77/n78/n79 5G Bands
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: In this work, a simple irregular shape patch antenna is designed, simulated, and analyzed for a Sub-6 GHz frequency of 5G applications. The suggested antenna is small and made up of two Z-shaped patches that are joined together, as well as an altered feedline built on an inexpensive duroid substrate (εr = 2.2, tanδ = 0.0009). The presented antenna is having impedance bandwidth of 3.6 - 5.6 GHz which covers partial n77 (3.3-4.2 GHz), n78 (3.3-3.8 GHz) band and complete n79 (4.4-5.0 GHz) communication bands of Sub-6 GHz. The 3-dB axial ratio bandwidth of 4.2-4.6 GHz is achieved in the proposed design. Circular polarization (CP) is achieved by etching the L-shaped slot in the ground plane and truncation of the patch. To explain the CP handedness, the surface current distribution plots are also investigated. The suggested model's conclusions make it a good candidate for 5G applications.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Two-Tier Hybrid Cryptographic Models for Secure Data Transactions in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Cloud computing is a trending and enormous technology. With the improvements in the field of Cloud computing, the main challenge arises in the transaction of data securely from one platform to another. Various cryptographic algorithms are used to provide a secure transaction of data. However, conventional cryptographic algorithms might not be sufficient enough for modern threats. To face these potential vulnerabilities, hybrid cryptographic algorithms can be the solution. Hybrid cryptography integrates multiple cryptographic algorithms to enhance performance and overall safety. RSA(Rivest-Shamir-Adleman) is the most common public key algorithm for encryption and decryption. This paper analyzes a modified form of RSA known as Modified-RSA that enhances security in hybrid cryptographic algorithms by incorporating three prime numbers instead of two. The Modified-RSA(MRSA) hybrid models are compared with the original RSA hybrid models with some theoretical and practical aspects. In this research, a comparative study of two-tier hybrid cryptographic models applied to secure data on the cloud is presented. Practical implementations were conducted with hybrid models of RSA and Modified-RSA using Python simulation. Encryption time, decryption time, average throughput, and efficiency were found using relatively more extensive data. The main motive was to find out the performance of every cryptographic hybrid and see which hybrid model is more efficient.

articleTitle: Improving Advanced Aero Cube Missions with a High-Gain Circularly Polarized Metallic Antenna Array
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: This research intends to help in the construction of a metallic patch antenna array for AeroCube missions using 1.5U CubeSat designs. It decides to use a low-profile, all-metal patch antenna array combined with the aluminum box of a 1.5U CubeSat to obtain a very high stiffness configuration for advanced space communication. As a result, the purpose of this research is to develop a unique metallic antenna array arrangement that is welded to the body of the 1.5U CubeSat and designed to deliver a low-cost, low-power, suitable, and high-performance AeroCube antenna system. The constructed antenna array is built of copper and tuned using the Quasi Newtonian Method to give a wide HPBW with a peak gain of around 12.5 dBi at Ka-band. Furthermore, it has a significant return loss and is circularly polarized, although taking up less than half of the 1.5U CubeSat's large face. The suggested metallic antenna array is lightweight and inexpensive, with a particularly stiff construction suitable for usage in space. As a consequence of these successes, advanced AeroCube missions may now be targeted using 1.5U CubeSat designs for very high-resolution CubeSat communication at a low cost and power consumption.

articleTitle: Computational Analysis to Elucidate Parkinson's Disease Pathophysiology and Therapeutics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a deadly disorder of the brain characterized by the deterioration of dopamine engendering neurons in the nervous system. The onset of PD is marked with a myriad of severe motor and non-motor symptoms, typically evident during advanced stages of the disorder. This underscores the urgent need for identification of druggable novel blood-based biomarkers for early detection and as potential therapeutic targets. In this study, we conducted a comprehensive analysis of blood-based transcriptome in both PD and healthy samples, aiming to identify novel transcriptomic biomarkers. Utilizing a blood-based microarray dataset from the NCBI's Gene Expression Omnibus, we pinpointed genes that are differentially expressed among Parkinson's and healthy control samples. Subsequently, we identified hub genes from these DEGs and assessed their significance through machine learning approach, employing their expression signatures as input features. Our machine learning analyses, utilizing artificial neural network and random forest algorithms, demonstrated that the expression signatures of these hub genes can effectively differentiate between PD and healthy conditions with accuracies of 71.42% and 78.57%, respectively. Finally, employing a molecular docking approach, we sought to identify novel natural compounds with potential therapeutic efficacy in PD treatment. In summary, our study contributes insights into blood-based biomarkers and potential treatment avenues for PD.

articleTitle: Bhaashaadarshi: A Novel Computational Language Model for Indian Languages with a Case Study in Kannada
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: This paper presents ‘Bhaashaadarshi’, a novel computational language model for all Indian languages. It consists of a new numerical representation and the distance and word alignment algorithms for measuring word similarity. This model is capable of connecting the grammar and phonetics of Indian languages, thus unifying the written and spoken Indian language models. In this paper, we explain the numerical representation, the distance and the alignment algorithms, considering Kannada language as the case study. This model is trained, tested with a few text mining applications, and evaluated manually using our private Kannada data corpus. ‘Bhaashaadarshi’ is a simple and efficient model compared to many AI -driven language models. It can address the ‘curse of multi linguality’ and can be used in Large Language Models.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Clinical Models on Sequential Clinical Text for AI Powered Medical Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Clinical terminologies are used by the experts to evaluate or conclude specific results based on the symptoms of the patients. The clinical terminologies used by the experts can be termed as aspects, aspect extraction is the major sub-task in any sentimental analysis. For the extraction of aspect from a given sentence, the existing natural language processing methods mainly focuses on the results generated by a pre-trained model. These pre-trained models work very well for normal English, however when it comes to clinical terminologies there exists a deficiency in generating the specific results. To address the issues related to clinical terminology. There exist multiple clinical models such as Clinical Big bird, Clinician Bert, Clinical Longformer which are transformer-based learning model which perform better against these clinical data. These models perform better on large dataset. In this paper, we would like to evaluate the performance of these Bio models with sequential clinical text and compare the performance of these models and evaluate context and coherence. The best results of these models will be presented to artificial bee colony for further optimization and integrate with an Artificial Intelligence based applications.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Enabled Smart Contracts in Agriculture: Enhancing Trust and Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: This study explores the important role of blockchain technology in the transformation of agriculture and presents a new way to integrate chatbots and smart contracts to solve the problem of persistence. Leverage the decentralized structure and security of the blockchain to increase traceability, transparency and fairness in agricultural product prices. A user-friendly chatbot built in Python using Tkinter that acts as a bridge between farmers and the Ethereum-based blockchain pricing algorithm. Smart contracts used in Solidity dynamically adjust crop prices based on the weather in real time, making it possible for prices to react and adjust. Simulations and tests in Ganache validate the proposed method, confirming its economic value and effectiveness in many agricultural cultures. This study delves into analytics, including latency and production time, to demonstrate the benefits of the blockchain model in creating transparent, farmer-centric and region-specific crop prices. The importance of this research is to support continuous change in agricultural technology, paving the way for the introduction of appropriate and fair prices. According to the amendment, the integration of advanced machine learning, further integration and collaboration with agricultural stakeholders should be developed in the future. This work sets a good path for agriculture, promoting transparency, fairness and quick access to the best crop prices, thus ensuring security and agricultural technology.

articleTitle: Fetal Heart Rate and Kicking Monitoring System for Pregnant Woman
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: This electronic document is about the integration of fetal heart rate (FHR) and kicking patterns monitoring as a comprehensive approach to antenatal care. By combining these parameters, a more holistic understanding of fetal well-being is achieved, enabling early detection of anomalies and fostering a proactive approach to maternal-fetal care. We discuss the technological advancements, including wearable devices and embedded electronics, that facilitate real-time monitoring. Despite the promising benefits, challenges such as ethical considerations and standardization need to be addressed. The integration of FHR and kicking patterns monitoring holds significant promise in improving prenatal care and maternal-fetal health outcomes. In addition, using the EMG (electromyography) sensor, uterine compression can be reproduced as a force output from the active area. Since we have information about the heart rate, it is possible to evaluate the mother in terms of stress. The frame is fully customizable and allows users to examine the fetus at home. Recent research has shown that integrating additional parameters, such as maternal stress levels and uterine compression, through technologies like EMG sensors, can further enhance the comprehensive approach to antenatal care. This approach not only offers a more detailed picture of fetal well-being but also empowers expectant mothers to actively participate in monitoring their baby's health. Moreover, the customizable nature of these monitoring systems allows for greater flexibility and convenience in prenatal care, potentially revolutionizing the field of maternal-fetal health.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Model Approach for Advanced Disease Identification in Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: This paper describes the in-depth study performed using various machine leaning models and showcases the power of Convolution Neural Networks (CNN) in image classification. Exploring machine learning architectures such as Generic CNN, ResNet50, EfficientNet V2, VGG16, DenseNet121, and the Hybrid Model, the study prioritizes Validation Accuracy. The hybrid model surpasses individual benchmark models in accuracy, showcasing its efficacy. This model is accessed in the form of a Flask Web Application. By integrating the strengths of the Hybrid model along with various other techniques to provide better results, our research endeavors to offer an efficient, diverse and accurate tool for disease identification.

articleTitle: SHAKTI Dual Lockstep Microprocessor: Ensuring Functional Integrity for Robust Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: With the advent of new processing technologies, electronics have become more susceptible to interference, making fault detection an essential component of devices to ensure their functional integrity. Ensuring functional integrity is a critical requirement for safety in applications like nuclear instrumentation, automotive electronics, aerospace systems, industrial automation, and medical devices. One of the prominent fault detection mechanisms used in processor-based devices is the dual lockstep structure. In this paper, we present the design and implementation of a dual lockstep processor based on the open source SHAKTI C-Class processor. The design is simulated and implemented on a Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA), and the results demonstrate its effectiveness in fault detection, ensuring functional safety. The synthesized results are compared with those of the base processor for area and performance.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Machine Learning Algorithms for Morphological Analysis of Maithili Language
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Maithili is an Indo-Aryan language spoken by approximately 36 million speakers in Bihar and Nepal. Presently very less work available for the language. Morphological analyzers are the important component of NLP, which is the motivation towards development of the tool for the computational recognition of language. In this paper we work towards development of morphological analyzer of resource poor language Maithili. We have created dataset of Maithili for morphological analysis, having morpheme and parts of speech classes for the words of the language. We have compared performance parameters like precision, recall, F-measure and accuracy using nine different machine learning algorithms. By comparing all we have found that Instance based learning algorithm is most suitable for designing morphological analyzer for Maithili language.

articleTitle: Smart Home Automation with Smart Metering Using ZigBee Technology and Deep Belief Networks – Optimization Using MB-ABCOA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: In the domain of smart homes and smart metering, ZigBee technology plays a pivotal role within the energy efficiency of homes, albeit facing challenges such as packet transmission delays and uneven energy consumption among nodes. To address these issues while emphasizing energy efficiency, we propose the Energy-efficient ZigBee Directionally Opportunistic Short-cut Trees Routings (EP-ZDOSTR), which optimizes network lifetimes and throughput by prioritizing energy-efficient packet transmission. Complemented by a hybrid Monarchy Butterfly and Artificial Bees Colonies Optimizations Algorithms (MB-ABCOA) approach, EP-ZDOSTR demonstrates significant improvements in network performances metric, including higher throughputs, increased packet delivery ratios, reduced transmission delays, and minimized energy consumption. Comparisons with existing methods like ZigBee shortcut tree routing (ZSTR), ZigBee opportunistic shortcut tree routing (ZOSTR), and Energy Efficient shortcut tree routing (EPSTR) validate its superiority in enhancing overall network efficiency and reliability. Furthermore, integrating ZigBee with Deep Belief Networks (DBNs) holds promise for further enhancing network intelligence, enabling predictive analysis of energy usage patterns and optimization of network operations, thereby advancing the capabilities of smart home in the context of smart homes and metering systems within the IoT landscape.

articleTitle: Sarcasm Detection of Emojis Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Sarcasm, often elusive in short tweets, poses a challenge for automated sentiment analysis. Our project melds NLP and machine learning to identify sarcastic tweets. We preprocess text for sarcasm clues like irony, hyperbole, and emojis, then train a classifier to predict sarcasm likelihood. We evaluate by splitting sentences, analyzing positive and negative sentiment words. Typically, sarcastic sentences lean toward negative sentiments in the second half. Detecting sarcasm in tweets is crucial for understanding social media conversations and sentiment trends. By leveraging NLP and machine learning, our method offers a promising solution to unravel the subtleties of sarcasm in digital communication. We aim to enhance the accuracy of sentiment analysis tools and improve their ability to capture the nuances of human expression in online discourse.

articleTitle: Delay Minimization Technique to improve the efficiency of Parameter Optimized Hysteretic Current Controlled Parallel Hybrid ETPA in Mobile Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: This paper proposes a delay minimization technique to improve the efficiency of a parameter-optimized hysteretic current-controlled parallel hybrid envelope tracking power amplifier (etpa). In a hysteretic current-controlled hybrid topology, a linear amplifier operates parallel with a hysteretic current-controlled switching converter. Block level simulation of etpa is performed using the simulink tool. The traditional parameter optimization technique is first implemented, and its limitation is analysed. The proposed delay minimization technique helps to overcome the limitation of the traditional approach and has been proven to be valid for any input frequency. The proposed technique offers an efficiency improvement of 14.9% compared to the traditional technique for an input frequency of 20mhz and provides an average efficiency improvement of 6.26% for an input frequency range of 2mhz to 60mhz.

articleTitle: Enhancing Road Safety with Real-time Driver Drowsiness Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: In these days there has been greater concern about the driver's drowsiness on road safety. According to the survey of the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) a greater percentage of fatalities, injuries and even deaths every year is because of drowsy driving. So, there is an immediate necessity to implement a system which detects the drowsiness of the driver and alerts the driver. These systems, which rely on visual behaviour analysis, hold the potential to significantly decrease accidents by providing timely alerts when drivers exhibit signs of drowsiness. These systems make use of cameras and computer vision algorithms, such as the Haar cascade classifier and CNN. These systems scrutinize facial features, eye movements, and other indicators to assess levels of alertness and identify signs of drowsiness. The cameras that are integrated continuously capture facial expressions, enabling the evaluation of eyelid closure for the Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR) and Mouth aspect ratio (MAR) across frames. If predefined thresholds for EAR values are surpassed, an alert system triggers, notifying both the driver and passengers. The real-time detection of driver drowsiness, reliant on visual behaviour analysis, carries immense potential to save lives, curtail accidents, and enhance economic outcomes. By promptly alerting drivers to their drowsy state, these systems serve as crucial preventatives of accidents while promoting safer driving practices.

articleTitle: Full Reference Image Quality Assessment (FR-IQA) of Pre-processed Structural Magnetic Resonance Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Deep learning-based Artificial Intelligence algorithms have surpassed human-level performance in many fields including medicine. Specifically in diagnosis using radiology images, deep neural networks empowered AI to excel by educating intricate nonlinear relationships which is a core part of the complicated radiology problems. However, these models require a massive amount of quality data for training. The accuracy of the deep learning model is based on the amount of training data and the quality of the trained data being fed. So, preprocessing the data from different capturing devices is inevitable. This study aimed to highlight some of the image quality metrics that can be used to quantify the efficiency of the chosen preprocessing pipeline. By quantifying the result of each preprocess step, the user can choose an optimal set of preprocesses that can greatly improve the image quality, leading to a high and accurate diagnosis through a deep learning model. Thus, this study detailed how the full reference image quality metrics can be used to validate the performance of sMRI preprocess tasks.

articleTitle: Effectiveness of metaverse in accelerating higher education
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The emergence of the metaverse represents a significant shift in understanding and interaction with digital environments. The Metaverse can potentially disrupt the education system by offering immersive and interactive virtual learning environments across geographical boundaries. Emerging technologies have covered the way for global learning and teaching methods through innovative pedagogy. This research investigates the transformative potential of integrating the Metaverse into higher education to achieve the desired learning outcomes and accessibility. It explicitly emphasizes various technologies like Augmented Reality, Virtual Reality, and Digital Twins and their significant applications in higher education. While these digital resources have numerous benefits, they also have many technical and infrastructural limitations in integrating the existing curricula into a digital environment. A higher education system that is more agile and digitally robust is better equipped to face and traverse disruptive occurrences. Hence, it is the need of the hour for education systems to adopt this technology to retain their prolonged existence and accessibility. The research further explores how the Metaverse can enrich learning experiences, promote collaboration and inclusivity, and meet the evolving requirements of educational learners. These learners are the key stakeholders, as their development of competencies is essential for effectively addressing challenges and creating value through problem-solving.

articleTitle: Assessment of Teaching, Learning and Student Progress in Computer Science Courses
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The Computer University of Myanmar conducted a comprehensive assessment of its computer science courses to maintain its reputation for academic excellence. The study focused on gathering genuine feedback from students to identify areas for improvement in curriculum, assessment, and learning outcomes. Both quantitative and qualitative data were collected using Likert forms, and text preprocessing techniques were applied for machine learning analysis. The results indicated predominantly positive student sentiments, reflecting the university's achievements. However, the study emphasized the need for continuous feedback to adapt to evolving student needs and sustain a commitment to academic excellence. The findings not only highlight the institution's dedication to quality but also provide a blueprint for ongoing improvement, ensuring the university's leadership in computer science education.

articleTitle: Optimized Configuration of an IRNSS S-band Microstrip Patch Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: This research work presents a comprehensive exploration into the optimization of an Indian Regional Navigation Satellite System (IRNSS) S-band microstrip patch antenna, catering to the increasing demand for compact antennas in satellite communication systems. Emphasizing superior performance and efficiency, the design aims to surpass existing techniques. Through meticulous parameter tuning, the antenna's capabilities have been refined for enhanced signal reception and transmission within the S-band frequency range. The optimization process entails a thorough analysis of diverse design parameters to ensure optimal radiation characteristics and impedance matching. Performance evaluations reveal good return loss, VSWR (voltage standing wave ratio), and radiation pattern stability. The proposed configuration not only meets but exceeds the requirements for satellite communication, marking a significant advancement in antenna design. Additionally, integration of supplementary filters enhances the antenna's performance by mitigating unnecessary interference, thus ensuring signal integrity. The usage additional filters to curb down the additional interference that may be introduced is a feasible way of restricting the antenna bandwidth to S-band's requirements while maintaining an excellent return loss value. These findings hold practical implications for IRNSS satellite systems, elevating their overall performance and reliability.

articleTitle: SentiNet: A Word-Cloud based approach towards Social Media Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Sentiment analysis of Twitter data has become an important tool for businesses, organizations, and individuals to understand public opinions and make informed decisions. This study offers a thorough examination of sentiment analysis methods used on dataset of tweets. The intent is to reliably classify tweets as positive or negative by utilizing advanced natural language processing and machine learning approaches. The goal is to provide a useful tool for businesses, researchers, and social media managers to analyze the sentiment of tweets related to their brand or events and make informed decisions based on the analysis. Data preprocessing, feature extraction using BOW, and the use of many machine learning models, such as K-Nearest Neighbours, Decision Trees, Random Forest, Naive Bayes, and LSTM, for sentiment classification are all part of the suggested methodology. The findings of the study highlight the efficacy of sentiment analysis in determining tweet's sentiments and underscore its potential for informing targeted marketing strategies and customer relationship management in the business sector. Additionally, the paper discusses potential future research directions, emphasizing the need for integrating more sophisticated deep learning models and exploring aspect-based sentiment analysis to provide comprehensive insights.

articleTitle: Facial-Based Autism Spectrum Disorder Diagnosis Using Enhanced Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Growing interest has been seen in the application of deep learning with facial image analysis to diagnose ASD in recent years. It has been demonstrated that deep learning algorithms can recognize minute facial characteristics linked to ASD. There are, nevertheless, a lot of unmet research needs in this field. In this work, we present a unique deep learning model that uses facial image analysis to diagnose ASD. Modern deep learning architecture Efficient Net serves as the foundation for our model. Additionally, we suggest a novel attention mechanism that enables our model to concentrate on the face traits that are most useful in diagnosing ASD. Using a dataset of 2500 face photos of children with ASD and generally developing kids, we assessed our model. Our model's accuracy of 85% is a considerable improvement above earlier models’ accuracy. Our findings imply that deep learning models may prove to be an effective diagnostic tool for ASD. Our model shows great promise since it can recognize tiny face traits linked to autism spectrum disorders.

articleTitle: Deep Residual Network for Effective Lung Cancer Detection on Computed Tomography Images
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Lung cancer has been listed as being one of the world's largest deadliest diseases. Lung diseases cause damage to lungs and can cause shortness of breath, turning fatal, if not treated at an early stage. The primary objective of this study is to identify malignant lung nodules in an input lung image and to categorize lung cancer and its severity. This study employs unique Deep learning approaches to determine the location of malignant lung nodules. The proposed approach uses Residual Network to detect and predict lung cancer from patients' Computer Tomography (CT) scan images with hyper parameter optimization. The results are compared with Convolutional Neural Network, VGG Net, and Inception <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$v3$</tex> architectures. The proposed approach attained an accuracy of 93.85 percent which is better than the existing approaches.

articleTitle: Smart Crowdfunding-Implementing Price-Triggered Transactions for Enhanced Decentralized Fundraising on Ethereum
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Crowd-funding, also known as crowd financing or crowd-sourcing of funds, has emerged as a popular alternative method for raising capital in recent years. In the dynamic realm of cryptocurrencies, this paper introduces a groundbreaking transaction system tailored to give users the autonomy to establish and maintain personalized price conditions for Ethereum (ETH) transactions. In response to the inherent volatility of cryptocurrency markets, the core objective of this system is to ensure the legitimacy of funds conveyed to campaign fundraisers. Users are endowed with the authority to stipulate the quantity of ETH they intend to transmit, define the initial USD valuation of ETH at the transaction's inception, and set a predetermined timeframe within which the transaction is slated for execution. This comprehensive approach yields a transparent and secure mechanism, ensuring the precision of transaction processing even amidst the market's capricious fluctuations. In scenarios where market conditions deviate from the user's predefined price, the system adeptly redirects funds to the campaign raiser, integrating the value of ETH at the user-designated moment, thereby fostering heightened reliability in cryptocurrency transactions.

articleTitle: Efficient Storage and Analysis of Videos through Motion-Based Frame Removal
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The storage and analysis of CCTV footage pose a significant challenge in modern surveillance systems. This paper presents an innovative and modern solution for efficient storage optimization and analysis through motion-based frame removal techniques. By leveraging the OpenCV library, redundant frames are removed, resulting in substantial storage reduction without losing important motion events. The methodology uses Python's OpenCV library with optional technologies such as Django, SQLite, and Bootstrap, ensuring reliability, scalability, usability, and effective data visualization. Experimental results have demonstrated the efficacy across different camera setups in different environments and their ability to preserve critical information. The approach offers a practical solution for decreasing cost, improving analysis efficiency, and enhancing usability. This research contributes to the field of CCTV surveillance by providing a practical and industry-oriented solution. The findings inspire further improvements in storage optimization and pave the way for more intelligent surveillance systems.

articleTitle: Automated Classification of Voltage Irregularities in Distribution System Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The present work focuses on classifying voltage irregularities in distribution systems by applying machine learning algorithms. These irregularities, encompassing notches and transients, can significantly impact the performance and stability of power distribution networks. Any fault in the power transmission system should be cleared up as quickly as possible. By automating the classification of voltage irregularities, we reduce the reaction time and hence reduce the fault clearance time. This study, therefore, carries substantial importance in the field of Power Quality, with the potential to enhance the robustness of distribution systems and the quality of power supplied to end-users. Several machine learning models were evaluated using the automated classifier using the Bayesian algorithm. The algorithm autonomously selects and trains classification models. The process involves data preprocessing, feature extraction, and model evaluation, leading to the automatic identification of voltage irregularities. Excellent accuracy of 99% has been achieved, which further signifies the reliability and importance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Change Maker: A Mobile Application Featuring Peoples Empowerment in Practicing Environment Friendly Habits and Tackling Climate Change
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: A third-world country like Bangladesh faces a number of issues like severe air and water pollution, energy waste, greenhouse gas emissions, waste littering, and natural disasters because of a lack of appropriate environmentally friendly habits, proper awareness, and government policy. The literary works that are currently available are only for creating environmental pollution monitoring systems. An online-based solution that empowers people to adopt eco-friendly behaviors, reduce pollution and energy waste, and address climate change issues is lacking in previous works. In order to address these issues, this paper proposes an eco-friendly and people-empowerment-aware mobile application that includes features such as green solutions for energy misuse, pollution, and waste management, green blogs, green event notifications such as seminars and programs, and users environment friendly status checking by answering questions about energy use, waste disposal, sanitation, and pollution events. The application allows users to donate to those impacted by climate change and includes rating and review features. According to user experience results, the proposed application met the needs of at least 74% users in terms of usability, design, and superior quality compared to existing schemes.

articleTitle: Identification of Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome through Clinical Metrics and Ultrasonographic Imaging Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS) is an endocrine disorder which is characterized by hormonal dysregulation and it commonly affects women during their reproductive age. The incident of an irregular or entirely missing monthly menstrual cycle can be attributed to a disturbance or imbalance in the complex interaction of hormonal secretions and their control mechanisms within the female reproductive system. The cause of Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) remains hard-to-find, lacking a universally acknowledged or defined factor responsible despite ongoing research efforts aimed at clarifying its origin and pathophysiology. PCOS symptoms like weight gain, facial hair, acne, and irregular cycles impede fertility. Weight management and preliminary intervention may reduce diabetes and heart risks, yet present techniques come up lacking in Early identification and prediction. We suggest a method using machine learning algorithms to predict Treatment for Polycystic Ovary Syndrome effectiveness based on Key criteria, striving for early detection using a Kaggle dataset. The paper incorporates the utilization of two different datasets aimed at facilitating the process of classification. Phase one entails identifying the primary features that contribute to PCOS and forecasting the onset of the disorder, where among different algorithms Random Forest gave the best accuracy. Phase two encompasses the utilization of an image dataset wherein the classification of images into infected or not infected of PCOS is carried out through the implementation of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs).

articleTitle: Safe-Guard: A Smartphone Application with Child Abuse Detection, Doctor Selection, Legal Aid, and Child Abuse Case Reporting Help Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Child abuse encompasses various forms of maltreatment, exploitation, and mental and sexual abuse of children. It is a major concern for children's health and personal lives. Apart from family members, other individuals who may abuse children include teachers, friends, relatives, and strangers. The previous literature did not deliver any online-based smartphone application for immediate child assistance when it came to analyzing features related to child abuse detection, such as question-and-answer sessions about physical, sexual, and mental abuse, the selection of doctors and lawyers based on user preferences, police force assistance, instant help post and family contact, question-and-answer sessions, nearby shelters, and fund collection for assistance for abused children. To assist children regarding abuse incidents, this article brings a smartphone application with child abuse detection by examining physical, mental, and sexual abuse incidents, doctor and lawyer selection and booking features with user cost, location, help area verification, police force assistance, instant help post, and family contact feature, question and answer session, nearby shelter and fund collection for abused children, contact us, and app rating submission features. The impact and app quality justification show that over 58 % of reviewers left positive comments about the proposed child abuse prevention assistance application.

articleTitle: Designing of Hybrid Renewable Energy Systems using Adaptive Switched Z-Source Converter and Prediction with AGO-RNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The hybrid system with the installation of grids is designed to acquire the Hybrid renewable energy systems. The proposed system presented the converts like, bidirectional converter and adaptive switched Z source converter (ASZC) incorporated with a battery storage model. The proposed ASZC is used to supply steady DC power to the inverter's DC link. The inputs are taken from the solar and wind power systems and the output of the systems is predicted using the proposed novel technique. The proposed system utilizes Adaptive Grasshopper optimization (AGO) based Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) for the hybrid system's output prediction. The entire model is simulated in the MATLAB/SIMULINK software to validate the performance of the proposed work and estimate the experimental outcomes. The recommended design is contrasted with current techniques and ensures the prediction output of the proposed work is higher.

articleTitle: ChatGPT as Assistive Technology: Opportunities and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The fusion of ChatGPT with Assistive Technology holds significant promise in improving accessibility and aiding individuals with diverse needs. Leveraging its language processing capabilities, this software facilitates customized interactions, enhancing user experiences within communication interfaces. By enabling adaptable interactions between humans and assistive technology, ChatGPT promotes effective communication through flexible interfaces. This research delves into the potential of integrating ChatGPT with assistive technology to enhance accessibility, providing personalized communication and technological aid for users with varying requirements. Through an exploration of these interactions, this study identifies numerous opportunities and outlines the top five of them. The integration of ChatGPT with assistive technology empowers individuals by furnishing advanced tools for text-based communication, content comprehension, and real-time assistance. This fosters more inclusive communication and support frameworks, catering to a broad spectrum of user needs. The synergistic partnership between ChatGPT and Assistive Technology serves as a catalyst for ongoing learning, transcending communication barriers, boosting productivity, and ultimately enhancing the overall quality of life for users with diverse needs. Through thorough exploration and innovative solutions, the integration of ChatGPT and Assistive Technology has the potential to revolutionize accessibility and support provision, creating a more inclusive and empowering digital environment for all users.

articleTitle: MediCrypt: A Model with Symmetric Encryption for Blockchain Enabled Healthcare Data Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: In the dynamic field of medicine, combining blockchain technology and data security becomes a vital strategy to solve the problem of protecting sensitive medical data. This study presents a new way to improve the security and privacy of medical data, using MediCrypt as an example of two- way encryption. Doctors initially used algorithms like AES or Blowfish to retrieve medical data. Smart contracts on the Ethereum-based blockchain introduce a layer of protection, combining SHA-256 with symmetric encryption technology. The multi-level transmission model includes encryption time, encryption time, elapsed time, and encryption size. Functionality in this model involves managing patient records (EHR), counterfeit drugs, drug reviews, clinical outcomes, and consent for all care areas. As shown in the methodology, the user ecosystem facilitates the exchange of information by defining the roles and responsibilities of doctors/pharmacists, administrators, and patients. The study shows the deployment of the MediCrypt model in three distinct stages. Distinct comparison of encryption time is done for different encryption algorithms. Also, parameters of MediCrypt model is compared with existing healthcare based blockchain models.

articleTitle: IoT Enabled Automotive Onboard Telemetry Recorder
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Addressing the global challenge of millions of annual deaths in accidents. This IoT-enabled Automotive Onboard Telemetry Recorder system, which uses MEMS sensors to monitor driver behavior and vehicle performance continuously, and GSM/GPS System, replaces traditional vehicle black boxes. In the event of an accident, the system uses the cloud-based IoT platform to alert the emergency services of the GPS-tracked vehicle location immediately. The recorded data is a valuable investigative resource, providing insights for post-incident analysis. An app also provides real-time monitoring and driver alerts, enhancing safety practices compactly and efficiently.

articleTitle: Visual Question Generation Framework for Chess Game State Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: In this study, we present a novel approach for generating questions from image captures of chess board states. The two main components of our approach are the creation of visual questions and the identification of chess pieces. Chess recognition employs a combination of computer vision and deep learning techniques to locate the chess board and identify the pieces on it. Visual question creation uses a template-based system to generate questions about the current state of the chess board. Our approach generates questions that require domain expertise and logical thinking, putting both human and machine participants' comprehension and reasoning skills to the test. We test our approach using a collection of chess board images, and we show that it can create questions that are both challenging and informative, as well as relevant and diverse. A template-based question generation method is used in this methodology to generate meaningful questions regarding a chess game. Our approach could be useful in a variety of circumstances, including chess education, analysis, and entertainment.

articleTitle: Towards Machine Learning Techniques for Enhanced Prediction of Coronary Artery Disease
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Heart disease affects and takes the life of one out of every four people. Different conditions affecting the heart and blood arteries are included in CVDs. Coronary artery disease (CAD), has a death rate of roughly 7 million each year. As a result, early and precise diagnoses of this disease are vital to improving overall survival chances for patients and sparing millions of lives. Machine learning can analyze and predict coronary artery disease in its initial stages. Machine learning algorithms can find complicated patterns and correlations, which is helpful in comparing different features and making predictions later. Some machine learning approaches combine the predictions from several different models to get a single, more powerful forecast. Three machine learning techniques were used in this study: Random Forest, extreme gradient boost, and Support Vector Machines. The sample data consisted of attributes and associated values from the UCI repository dataset. To remove any missing values, data preparation techniques were used. In this study, Voting classifier learning is used for the prediction model. The model used in this study provides an accuracy of 87% on the provided dataset.

articleTitle: Partition Explainer Next Generation in Single Image Dehazing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: This paper investigates the field of Explainable Artificial Intelligence (xAI), focusing two well-known models, namely LIME and SHAP. It presents a methodology to refine the interpretability and transparency of image classification tasks. This research thoroughly examines feature classes in both hazy and haze-free images by utilizing the pre-built ImageNet network for comprehensive analysis using a partition explainer. A thorough examination is performed to analyze the image classification, demonstrating the complicated systems behind decision-making. In addition to that, it plays a crucial role in the identification and resolution of issues in single-image dehazing models created using machine and deep learning methods. The results of this study make a substantial contribution to the recent trend on the interpretability of models, discovering new opportunities for advancements in AI-powered image processing. The partition explainer demonstrate transparency, which has the potential to enhance and optimize image classification models. It helps to build trust and understanding between humans and machines.

articleTitle: Study & Analysis of a Free Space Optical Link Between a Sun Synchronous LEO Satellite and a GEO Satellite
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: This research comprehensively investigates a free space optical communication link established between a sun-synchronous LEO (low earth orbit) satellite and a GEO (geostationary) satellite positioned at a 55-degree east sub-satellite point. Unlike previous models limited to LEO-to-ground connections, this study illuminates the superiority of establishing an optical LEO-to-GEO link, unveiling unprecedented advantages in data transmission efficiency, latency reduction, and reliability enhancement, thus setting a new standard in satellite communication protocols. The research outlines the intricate technical aspects and challenges of establishing an inter-satellite optical communication link. It also focuses on variations in LEO access times, LEO to GEO and GEO to ground connections. Furthermore, the investigation delves into the precise determination of link margin that accounts for various factors affecting the transmitted signal's propagation in free space, including free space path attenuation, pointing losses and system noise losses. The findings and insights derived from this research are fundamental in advancing the understanding of free space optical communication technology for inter-satellite links. Enhanced data rates, low latency, and improved reliability are some of the improved deliverables this research provides us.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Framework to Find Optimal ROI for Contactless Heart Rate Variability Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Recent interest in healthcare has led to increased research on image-based non-contact health diagnosis devices, particularly machine learning models that measure heart rates using facial images. Variations in light diffusion information caused by inconsistent epidermis on the face make it difficult to determine which areas of the face should be targeted during the actual application. A few recent studies have reported experimental results for their designated regions of interest (ROIs) without providing a valid justification for their selection. This study's primary objective is to provide a comprehensive analysis of the various facial regions to determine which ROI is best suited for accurately detecting heart rate variability (HRV). Three anatomically divided facial regions were analyzed using the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) and FFT combined with Principal Component Analysis (PCA) under both laboratory and controlled illumination conditions, using sliding windows of 3 × 3 and 8 × 8 dimensions for real-time data analysis. The study revealed a high correlation between acquired results and ground truth data when detecting HRV using a particular ROI compared to the other ROIs. Under laboratory and controlled illumination conditions, the ROI on the left cheek performed remarkably well. In addition, significant results were also observed for the forehead and left facial regions of interest (ROIs) under controlled illumination.

articleTitle: Clustering and Energy Efficient Power Allocation Scheme for D2D Multicast Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The multimedia content dissemination services with the current cellular networks still met several challenging while performing desired performance. Recently, the improvement of energy efficiency is not considered in most of the existing works and for all receiving users, they discussed about how to deliver reasonable QoS. Based on multicast network, this work proposed a novel framework to solve resource allocation as well as clustering in device-to-device (D2D). This study introduce a novel adaptive energy valley optimization (AEVO) model to enhance the clustered and power allocation with energy efficient. While considering the requirement of QoS in D2D, an efficient power control mechanism and resource allocation is maximized complete D2D multicast clusters energy-efficiency. By doing this, higher computational difficulties with energy-efficiency problems are solved by proposing novel allocation of power model. Based on the existing methods, the proposed algorithm indicated good numerical results with respect to energy consumption and throughput.

Author Keywords: D2D multicast network and Adaptive energy valley optimization

articleTitle: BER Performance Analysis of OTFS-IM Systems under Barrage Jamming
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The Orthogonal Time-Frequency Space (OTFS) with Index Modulation (OTFS-IM) system conveys information using M-ary constellation symbols and active sub carrier indices. Recently, researchers have focused on this technique as an option for future wireless communication systems due to its superior performance over OTFS and previous modulations such as Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) and OFDM with Index Modulation (OFDM-IM). This study investigates the effect of barrage jamming on the performance of an OTFS-IM system, employing maximum likelihood (ML), minimum mean square error (MMSE), and log-likelihood ratio (LLR) detectors with a 3GPP-defined tapped delay line (TDL) channel. Simulation results show that OTFS-IM outperforms OTFS and OFDM-IM in bit error rate (BER) at high signal-to-jamming ratio (SJR) levels, but experiences more impact from barrage jamming at lower SJR levels. Additionally, the ML detector is observed to be less complex than the LLR detector.

articleTitle: Crop Yield Forecasting Based on Echo State Network Tuned by Crayfish Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The agriculture sector, once reliant only on external inputs for increased yields, faces repercussions of diminished natural systems and significant environmental impact. High-precision agriculture aims to curb excessive usage of fertilizers and pesticides while prioritizing sustainability. Modern technologies can shape decisions toward the betterment of soil health, plant protection, and yield enhancement. Predictive models employing machine learning aid farmers in crop performance estimation, disease detection, soil health assessment, and yield prediction among others. These insights inform field operations, logistics, and contract negotiations. Leveraging machinery data, weather data, and drone imagery using machine learning can help us refine farming practices. Recurrent neural networks (RNN) can aid in various farming challenges like plant stress detection and irrigation. Yet, challenges persist in optimizing hyperparameters, a task we tackled using the nature-inspired crayfish optimization algorithm (COA) adapted to tune echo state networks (ESN) for multivariate time series forecasting of crop yield. This study demonstrates the utility of machine learning in agriculture, enabling yield assessment for improved sustainability.

articleTitle: Applying Machine Learning to Enhance Intrusion Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: Gadget up to date has shown its effectiveness in several packages, identifying styles and detecting anomalies. One such software enhances intrusion detection structures (IDS), which are essential for shielding up-to-date networks from malicious attacks. However, as the complexity and quantity of network information updated, traditional IDS strategies are becoming much less efficient and accurate. This technical summary focuses on the software of system learning techniques up to date enhance IDS. Specially, we explore how supervised, unsupervised, and deep learning algorithms can be used come across and respond up-to-date anomalies in network those algorithms can analyze and adapt up to date new assault styles, making them extra powerful at detecting and up-to-date cyber-attacks. Furthermore, they can manage massive amounts of records without compromising accuracy, making them appropriate for actual-time intrusion detection.

articleTitle: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: In this day and age, there has been a growing concern about the high prevalence of serious medical conditions mainly among women. This project focuses on Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS), a common and severe health condition affecting females worldwide. Long term consequences like increased risk of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and Gestational Diabetes can be mitigated through early detection and management of PCOS. However, complications associated with PCOS may be better managed if detected early enough. The purpose of our project is to construct a strong diagnostic model using ensemble learning and machine learning techniques. Besides random forest, catboost classifier; XGBoost, KNN, howbeit we have integrated further models such as Support Vector Machines (SVM). We test our approach on a benchmark PCOS dataset using both 70:30, 80:20 split ratios with the XGBoost algorithm attaining an impressive accuracy level of 99% compared to other models.

articleTitle: Detecting AI-generated images with CNN and Interpretation using Explainable AI
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Communications (InC4)
abstract: The rapid proliferation of digitally manipulated images in various media outlets has necessitated the development of robust and reliable methods for distinguishing between authentic and synthetic visual content. In response to this imperative, this research leverages state-of-the-art deep learning techniques and an extensive dataset of ‘real’ and ‘fake’ images to create an AI model for image identification.
